lines.say: [cheerfully] Hi! Let me show you how to get started with RepairClock, step by step.
lines.cap: Hi! Let me show you how to get started with RepairClock, step by step.

lines.say: It only takes a few minutes, and you can follow along as you watch.
lines.cap: It only takes a few minutes, and you can follow along as you watch.

lines.say: [cheerfully] Step one: create your free account.
lines.cap: Step 1: create your free account.

lines.say: Click 'Start free trial', then type your name, your work email and a password.
lines.cap: Click “Start free trial”, then type your name, your work email and a password.

lines.say: There's no card needed, and the first fourteen days are free.
lines.cap: There’s no card needed, and the first 14 days are free.

lines.say: [cheerfully] Step two: set up your agency.
lines.cap: Step 2: set up your agency.

lines.say: Choose 'Letting agent' and 'Scotland', then add your agency's name and phone number.
lines.cap: Choose “Letting agent” and “Scotland”, then add your agency’s name and phone number.

lines.say: They'll appear on the letters your tenants receive.
lines.cap: They’ll appear on the letters your tenants receive.

lines.say: [cheerfully] Step three: add your homes.
lines.cap: Step 3: add your homes.

lines.say: Open 'Homes', and upload a spreadsheet from your property software, or add them one by one.
lines.cap: Open “Homes”, and upload a spreadsheet from your property software, or add them one by one.

lines.say: There's a template to download, if you need one.
lines.cap: There’s a template to download, if you need one.

title: Log a damp or mould report

lines.say: [cheerfully] Step four: when a tenant reports damp or mould, click 'Log a report'.
lines.cap: Step 4: when a tenant reports damp or mould, click “Log a report”.

lines.say: Pick the home, describe the problem, and say when you found out.
lines.cap: Pick the home, describe the problem, and say when you found out.

lines.say: RepairClock works out every legal deadline for you, skipping weekends and bank holidays.
lines.cap: RepairClock works out every legal deadline for you, skipping weekends and bank holidays.

lines.say: [cheerfully] Step five: need the landlord to approve a repair?
lines.cap: Step 5: need the landlord to approve a repair?

lines.say: Open the case, add the work and the price, and send them a link.
lines.cap: Open the case, add the work and the price, and send them a link.

lines.say: They approve in seconds, with no login, and their answer is saved on the case.
lines.cap: They approve in seconds, with no login, and their answer is saved on the case.

lines.say: [cheerfully] Step six: after the visit, record what was found.
lines.cap: Step 6: after the visit, record what was found.

lines.say: RepairClock drafts the tenant's written summary for you.
lines.cap: RepairClock drafts the tenant’s written summary for you.

lines.say: Check it, click 'Issue written summary', and it's emailed in your agency's name.
lines.cap: Check it, click “Issue written summary”, and it’s emailed in your agency’s name.

lines.say: [cheerfully] Step seven: invite your team.
lines.cap: Step 7: invite your team.

lines.say: In 'Settings', type a colleague's email, and click 'Send invitation'.
lines.cap: In “Settings”, type a colleague’s email, and click “Send invitation”.

lines.say: Everyone gets their own login.
lines.cap: Everyone gets their own login.

lines.say: [cheerfully] Step eight: pick your plan, whenever you're ready.
lines.cap: Step 8: pick your plan, whenever you’re ready.

lines.say: Open 'Plan and billing'. Most agencies choose 'Agent': up to three hundred homes and five people, for ninety-nine pounds a month, plus VAT.
lines.cap: Open “Plan & billing”. Most agencies choose “Agent”: up to 300 homes and 5 people, for £99 a month + VAT.

lines.say: You can switch or cancel at any time.
lines.cap: You can switch or cancel at any time.

lines.say: [cheerfully] And that's it, you're all set!
lines.cap: And that’s it, you’re all set!

lines.say: Each morning, your 'Today' page shows what's due, and your team gets a reminder email.
lines.cap: Each morning, your “Today” page shows what’s due, and your team gets a reminder email.

lines.say: Start your free trial today. The link's on your screen. See you inside!
lines.cap: Start your free trial today. The link’s on your screen. See you inside!
